aosSalesConfig.note: Owner sales/design selections layered on the manufacturer records. They do not change manufacturer facts and are not manufacturer, code or supplier approval.

selections.behavior: Westbury Tuscany C10 (square vertical pickets) is the initial/default Westbury selection; other eligible verified families remain available.

verification.note: Black Fine Texture is one of the 12 boxed finishes and one of the 4 assembled-section finishes for Tuscany.

selections.behavior: One default finish, with independent overrides by deck edge. Stairs inherit the adjoining railing by default and may be changed per stair (W10).
Held out of sales selections until cleared. Researched records kept for future review; not selectable for quotes.

verification.note: DSI: Montego Series has NOT been tested for any building codes.

selections.behavior: 36 in default; 42 in available, subject to model/configuration compatibility and project requirements.

verification.note: All families list 36/42; exceptions in library (e.g. VertiCable 7-8 ft sections and assembled sections 36 in only).

selections.behavior: Surface plate mounting only for the initial release. Fascia, core-drill and other types stay in the research catalog but are not initial sales options.

verification.note: Surface-plate types exist: post with plate (37/43/47/53 in) and crossover/corner crossover with plate (36/42 in).

selections.behavior: Prefer 2 in posts where manufacturer-approved; upgrade as needed for family, section/span, height and connections. Never force a 2 in post on an incompatible assembly.

verification.note: DSI's posts page does not state which post size each family, height, section length or gate requires. 2 in Heavy Duty and 2-1/2 in Power posts are marked IRC; 2-1/2 in Power also IBC and Miami-Dade.

selections.behavior: Offer only when supported by manufacturer-approved components for the selected model/finish/configuration.

verification.note: Tuscany page lists a 'Deck Drink Rail Adapter' under 'Works Well With' but gives no dimensions or compatibility limits; no wide top rail profile is listed.

selections.behavior: Include verified compatible Westbury gates as a separate sales add-on.

verification.note: Tuscany gates: single openings 36/48/60 in, double 72/96/120 in, adjustable, custom sizes. Gate hardware, post requirements and per-family/finish compatibility not verified.

selections.behavior: Inherit the adjoining deck edge by default; allow per-stair overrides without altering the deck edge or other stairs.
Suggest Tuscany as a fallback and require James's confirmation. Never silently change a selected product; do not claim universal compatibility.

verification.note: Transition hardware between a non-matching family and Tuscany stair sections (posts, rails, attachment) not verified.

selections.behavior: Both sides on by default, with separate left/right controls per staircase. Regulatory guard/handrail requirements are verified separately.
Independent Westbury system/model AND finish on each deck-edge section.
Ask James each time whether to keep or replace existing manual overrides. Never silently overwrite and never auto-keep without asking. (Differs from AOS wood railing.)
Share one post at a corner only where the selected assemblies are compatible and the connection is approved; count one physical post once.

verification.note: Corner post compatibility between different families/finishes and connection approval not verified.

selections.behavior: Offer only manufacturer-verified, compatible post-cap and lighting options; if uncertain, do not present as approved.

verification.note: DSI lists Flat Cap and Ball Cap, two-piece flair, deck post lights and Low Voltage LED Deck Lighting; Tuscany 'available with Magena Star Lighting'. Cap/light finishes and per-post compatibility not published.

openItems: Exact model-to-finish/height/section combinations, certified post and mounting choices, max post spacing and current evaluation reports.
Whether 2 in posts are approved for each selected assembly, including gate loads and corner/stair junctions.
Tuscany fallback transitions for non-matching stair families.
Supplier availability, lead times, AOS stock colors (white/black/bronze) and exact finish names.
Drink-rail assemblies, gate components, post caps and lighting, including media/texture rights.
Structural guard connections, code requirements, warranty and installation instructions before construction/takeoff use.
behaviorRules: James operates the app; keep selection simple and minimize scrolling.
Show the entire eligible verified lineup (except held or incompatible products) with Tuscany C10 / Black Fine Texture / 36 in / surface mount as initial defaults.
Track one default selection and finish plus per-edge system/model and finish overrides; stairs inherit the adjoining edge until overridden.
When the default Westbury product changes, ask James whether to keep or overwrite manual edge/stair overrides; preserve geometry, stairs, placement, selections and stair controls.
Gates are a separate compatible add-on; drink rails, lighting and post caps appear only where support is documented.
Shared posts are one physical component when approved; component mapping and takeoffs must not imply an unverified assembly is adequate.
A catalog record does not mean the product is implemented or tested in Deck Studio.
